meta.name: pirate_vs_unicorn_war
meta.prompt: A pirate island and a unicorn island, at war.

programs.brief: A menacing heavy pirate dreadnought warship bristling with dark oak cannon decks, torn black sails, skull carvings across the sterncastle, and an iron ram pointed at the unicorn island.
A colossal rearing unicorn colossus sculpted from glowing white quartz and amethyst crystal, standing atop a fortified sanctuary bastion facing the pirate naval lines.
A levitating purple amethyst arcane focus crystal surrounded by rotating polished brass warding rings, radiating defensive light against incoming cannon shells.

tokens.event_direction: pirate gunships and shoreline batteries bombard the unicorn island across the narrow strait
tokens.infra: cannon_battery along the pirate bluffs pointing seaward; barricade_line and palisade along the unicorn island landing beaches
